themes.title: Elite Theory
themes.one_line: Who actually decides, and how that differs from the story on the news.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of power, not a hunt for bloodlines.
themes.why: The envelope is often an elite consensus posing as weather. Name the machinery.

resources.title: The Power Elite
resources.one_line: The mid-century map of interlocking civic, military, and economic command.

themes.title: Noblesse Oblige
themes.one_line: Privilege and high status carry a duty to act responsibly toward those with less of both.
themes.guardrail: An alternative welfare grammar. Duty, not blood.
themes.why: The envelope insists the current welfare model is the only welfare model.

resources.title: The Revolt of the Elites and the Betrayal of Democracy
resources.one_line: Contrasts rooted, landed aristocracies with modern cosmopolitan meritocrats who treat privilege as purely earned and owe nothing to the places they leave.
resources.guardrail: Historian and social critic. Class and place, not folk-biology.

themes.title: Cyclical History
themes.one_line: Civilisations do not progress forever in a straight line. They thicken, peak, decay, and start again.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of history. Cycles of institutions, not races.
themes.why: Challenges the official story of endless accumulating progress.

resources.title: The Prophets of Doom
resources.one_line: A survey of thinkers who reject the endless-progress view of history.
resources.guardrail: Read as a map of cyclical theories. Parvini is a source, not a mascot.

themes.title: Esotericism
themes.one_line: Challenge your preconceptions and update your priors.
themes.guardrail: Hidden knowledge as method — psychogeography, mythic cities, avant-garde. Not a soil-cult and not an initiation fee.
themes.why: The official page treats only the approved surface as real. Some English writing treats the city and the infrastructure as a palimpsest.

resources.title: Lud Heat
resources.one_line: Hawksmoor churches, ley lines, and the city's buried geometry — infrastructure as a haunted diagram.
resources.guardrail: Psychogeography. English soil here is a map, not a race-myth.

resources.title: Albion: The Origins of the English Imagination
resources.one_line: London as a living, cyclical organism — history and memory repeating through the stones of the street.
resources.guardrail: Psychogeography and mythic topography. Not occult nationalism.
